name: Tezcat

traits.name: Chameleon
traits.description: Tezcat skin mimics the colours of their surroundings, a natural camouflage that operates automatically while conscious. They gain DM+2 to all Stealth checks. Because they also shift colour as unconscious body language, they find lying to each other hard: DM-2 to Deception checks made against another Tezcat.

traits.name: Fast Metabolism
traits.description: Tezcat have a heightened metabolism and very fast reactions, gaining DM+1 to all Initiative rolls.

traits.name: Heightened Senses
traits.description: Tezcat eyes are adapted to low light: DM+1 to checks requiring sight in low-light (not total darkness), but DM-1 in light equivalent to a sunny Terran day unless wearing eye protection. Their more sensitive smell, hearing and taste grant DM+1 to Recon or Survival checks using one of those senses.

traits.name: Manual Dexterity
traits.description: Tezcat have very fine motor control, gaining DM+2 to any check requiring fine manipulation.

traits.name: Natural Weapons
traits.description: Sharp teeth and claws make nasty close-combat weapons: claws do 1D+1 damage, bite does 1D+2. A bite that penetrates armour also delivers venom — the victim must make an Average (8+) END check or take an additional D3 damage at 1D-minute intervals. Tezcat are immune to their own venom when ingested, but not when bitten.

source: Aliens of Charted Space Vol. 4, Mongoose Publishing
